content:
200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully retrieved the agent safe mode summary.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The unique ID of the container associated with the user's API
keys.
container_uuid
string
The unique ID of the user that requested the agent summary.
string
The cloud region in which the container is located.
object
The number of agents in safe mode by version and operating
system platform.
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the
summary was requested.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to view the agent safe mode summary.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management encountered an internal server error. Wait a moment,
and try your request again.
